pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, dark urban atmosphere)

Morning sirens
echo in the distance
the city breathing
through concrete walls

[Verse 1]
Every morning starts
like a quiet battle
a tired heart
under a careful smile

Scars stay hidden
behind polite faces
but tonight
the silence feels too tight

[Chorus]
So I step outside
into the restless night

The city lights
flicker like small fires

Somewhere inside
a spark is waking

A quiet blaze
moving through the dark

[Verse 2]
Glass towers rising
like endless forests
holding voices
that never shout

Masks fall slowly
into the evening wind
and the streets begin
to breathe again

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo, tense then slowly rising)

[Bridge]
One breath
then another

A small flame
in a tired chest

Not anger
not destruction

Just the sound
of something finally breaking open

[Chorus]
Now the night moves
a little louder

Footsteps echo
through burning lights

The city sky
glows a little brighter

And somewhere
the storm begins

[Outro]
(soft piano outro, fading into distant city ambience)

Ash drifts slowly
through neon air

And the quiet fire
keeps moving
through the night
